name: Brier score
applicability_rule: Apply only to the same target definition and horizon
minimum_sample: Pre-register sample; calibration evidence uses at least 30 labels per window
limitations: Depends on class balance and target construction

name: Expected calibration error 10-bin
applicability_rule: Use registered ten-bin reliability method with distinct current and reference windows
minimum_sample: At least 30 labeled outcomes in each calibration window
limitations: Result depends on binning and sample size

name: Maximum drawdown
applicability_rule: Require verified opening snapshot and hash-chained accounting history
limitations: Does not authenticate the source or replace risk limits

name: Net profit and loss
required_inputs: Event-sourced fills fees funding and cash flows
applicability_rule: Use reconciled ledger and retain cost components separately
minimum_sample: Pre-register evaluation window and event coverage
limitations: Historical profit does not establish future performance

name: Sharpe ratio
required_inputs: Ordered return series and sampling convention
applicability_rule: Pre-register annualization risk-free rate and return frequency
limitations: Unstable under nonstationarity and multiple testing
